notes.title: 🔥 Maseylia Demo 2.0 – Major Update! New Audio, Combat & More!
notes.notes:
🚀 Maseylia: Echoes of the Past – Demo 2.0 is Live!

[previewyoutube=r5LmPe4dun4;full][/previewyoutube]

This update is the result of months of hard work and your incredible feedback from Steam Fest. One of the biggest changes is a complete rework of the music & sound design, creating a much more immersive atmosphere!

🔥 What’s New in Demo 2.0?
🎵 A complete overhaul of music & sound design for a richer atmosphere
✅ A brand-new protagonist with improved animations
✅ Overhauled lighting & atmospheric effects
✅ New zones & NPCs to enrich the world
✅ A 3D interactive map for better navigation
✅ Reworked combat & level design, shaped by your feedback


👾 Join the discord for exciting updates and discussions coming soon: https://discord.com/invite/CcbTucsSVY

Thank you all for your support! Your feedback has been invaluable in making Maseylia better than ever.

notes.title: Update: Performance Boost, New Areas, Enemies, Boss, and Enhanced Graphics!
notes.notes:
In this major update for Maseylia: Echoes of the Past, we’ve worked hard to provide a smoother and more immersive experience. Here’s what’s new:

[b]Improved Performance:[/b] For example, The game now runs at 90fps on Steam Deck for unparalleled fluidity (up from 25/30fps on the last version)

[b]New Introduction Area:[/b] Explore a brand-new area that further expands the world of Maseylia.

[b]New Boss and Areas:[/b] Discover new passages and face a powerful new boss.

[b]Artistic Direction Overhaul:[/b] Enjoy varied lighting and atmospheric particle effects for deeper immersion.

[b]New Enemies and Complete Rebalancing:[/b] After one month of community feedback, the game has been fully adjusted for a better gameplay experience.

[b]Get ready to rediscover Maseylia with these new features and improvements![/b]
